rationale: Retain one ACT platform and correct the stale transaction treatment. Blackstone Energy Transition Partners announced a majority investment on March 11, 2026 and Houlihan Lokey confirms that it closed on May 19, 2026. The FTC identifies BETP IV and regulatory materials identify Rocket Purchaser as the acquisition vehicle. Unsupported Q-Dot and PCM Products milestones are replaced with the verified announcement, close and capacity-expansion events.

supports: The BETP majority investment closed on May 19, 2026
Blackstone Energy Transition Partners announced a majority ACT investment on March 11, 2026
BETP IV was the acquiring fund
ACT is one Lancaster-based thermal-management platform founded in 2003

companyFieldUpdates.description: Advanced Cooling Technologies (ACT) designs and manufactures thermal-management components and systems, including two-phase cooling, heat pipes, phase-change materials, cold plates and environmental-control units. The Lancaster, Pennsylvania-based platform serves data centers, advanced computing, defense, space, electronics, medical, industrial and HVAC markets, with additional integrated operations in York, Pennsylvania and Anaheim, California. Blackstone Energy Transition Partners announced a majority investment on March 11, 2026 and the transaction closed on May 19, 2026 through BETP IV; the exact percentage and management rollover are not publicly disclosed. ACT announced more than $5 million of additional capacity investment, a planned 50,000-square-foot facility and up to 100 new jobs in July 2026. No later sale, transfer or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.
